     2	name: report-chapter-one-generation
     3	description: "Orchestrate the fixed Markdown first-chapter workflow for the 额勒赛上电站 dam monitoring report: prepare the 【1】～【11】 reference catalog, draft from 【0】, resolve first-round gaps, validate evidence, generate the audited Markdown, and normalize it into formal report language. Use when starting, resuming, supplementing, validating, formalizing, or reporting progress for this first-chapter experiment."
     4	---
     5	
     6	# 第一章报告工作流
     7	
     8	作为第一章实验的唯一顶层编排入口，按“前置阶段 + STEP1～STEP5”推进。调用
     9	`$build-reference-filemap` 完成索引和查询，不在本 SKILL 复制其技术实现。
    10	
    11	只处理固定第一章及 Markdown 审计产物；不生成第二章以后内容、DOCX/PDF、可靠性/完备性评价或
    12	工程安全结论。
    13	
    14	## Read First
    15	
    16	1. 读取 `docs/feature/report-generation/MVPGOAL.md`，获取目标、当前阶段、验收和停止条件；
    17	2. 读取 `docs/collaboration/reference/MVPGOALTemplate.md`，只采用标题、顺序和表格形态；
    18	3. 读取当前实验的 `source-manifest.json`、`chapter-1-evidence.json`、缺口和非交互处置；
    19	4. STEP2 还要读取前置阶段的 `build-manifest.json`、catalog 和 graph；
    20	5. 按当前阶段读取本 SKILL 直接链接的一个 reference，不提前加载其他阶段细节。
    21	
    22	Template 正文、索引 metadata、Graph 边和查询结果都不是报告事实来源。
    23	
    24	## Skill Topology
    25	
    26	```mermaid
    27	flowchart TD
    28	    O["$report-chapter-one-generation\n唯一编排入口"] --> P["前置阶段"]
    29	    P --> I["$build-reference-filemap\n索引、Graph、查询"]
    30	    P --> S1["STEP1\n【0】初稿与缺口"]
    31	    S1 --> S2["STEP2\n【1】～【11】定向补证"]
    32	    S2 --> S3["STEP3\n多阶段校核"]
    33	    S3 --> S4["STEP4\n审计型 Markdown"]
    34	    S4 --> S5["STEP5\n正式报告规范化"]
    35	```
    36	
    37	## Durable Stage Contract
    38	
    39	| 阶段 | 唯一职责 | 必需产物 | Gate |
    40	|---|---|---|---|
    41	| 前置阶段 | 为【1】～【11】建立候选资料检索基础设施 | technical filemap、raw metadata、tag vocabulary/registry、SQLite catalog、tag Graph、build manifest | 一文件一模型输入且 metadata 全覆盖；FTS、tag 过滤、实体层级和 Graph 冒烟通过 |
    42	| STEP1 | 仅用【0】按 Template 生成初稿并登记全部缺口 | `chapter-1.md`、`source-manifest.json`、`chapter-1-evidence.json` | 固定章节 100%；每节有 EvidenceRef 或稳定 Gap ID |
    43	| STEP2 | 仅按 STEP1 Gap 查询【1】～【11】并回读原文补证 | `gap-resolution.json`、补充后的 evidence | 每个 Gap 为采纳、冲突或未解决；采纳项有原文 EvidenceRef |
    44	| STEP3 | 对【0】～【11】执行来源、事实、跨资料和报告四层校核 | `chapter-1-facts.json`、`validation-report.json`、非交互冲突处置清单 | 结构化事实通过 schema/复算；每个冲突已保留来源并冻结禁止声明 |
    45	| STEP4 | 只用通过 STEP3 的结构化事实生成审计型 Markdown | 审计型 `chapter-1.md`、最终 evidence、验证摘要 | 结构、证据、实体、数值、表格和缺口披露全部通过 |
    46	| STEP5 | 在不改变事实的前提下规范为正式报告文体 | 正式 `chapter-1.md`、`formal-wording.json`、`formalization-report.json` | 禁用研究措辞为 0；事实、EvidenceRef、表格、限制和冲突保真；字节级重放通过 |
    47	
    48	当前阶段的 gate 未通过时不得进入下一阶段。每个后续实验目录必须声明 `parent_experiment_id`，不得覆盖
    49	前一阶段产物。
    50	
    51	## 前置阶段 — Build Index and Graph
    52	
    53	调用 `$build-reference-filemap`，范围固定为允许检索的【1】～【11】。该阶段只建立候选路由层：
    54	
    55	- technical filemap 冻结路径、哈希、格式和结构；
    56	- Excel 记录每个 Sheet 的结构和物理前 10 行；
    57	- `$extract-reference-metadata-tags` 以一文件一模型输入提取 `title`、`summary` 和 typed raw tags；
    58	- 全量扫描结束后统一归并同义 tag，并建立实体层级 registry；
    59	- SQLite FTS 和 tag Graph 支持全文、canonical tag、实体层级与相关文件查询；
    60	- metadata 不要求逐字段 locator，查询结果必须在 STEP2 回读原文件后才能转成 EvidenceRef。
    61	
    62	索引和 Graph gate 未通过时可以先完成 STEP1，但不得开始 STEP2。
    63	
    64	## STEP1 — Draft from 【0】
    65	
    66	读取 [`references/step1-primary-draft.md`](references/step1-primary-draft.md)，仅使用【0】生成第一章初稿。
    67	为每个固定小节整理“可写事实、EvidenceRef、Gap、Conflict”，为 Gap 分配稳定 ID，并形成第二轮待办。
    68	
    69	STEP1 允许以 `PASSED_WITH_GAPS` 交付；Gap 进入后续机器检索，不创建人工输入请求，也不得为了看似完整而跨目录补写或使用 Template 示例事实。
    70	
    71	## STEP2 — Gap-driven Supplement
    72	
    73	读取 [`references/step2-gap-supplement.md`](references/step2-gap-supplement.md)。逐个 Gap 使用 catalog 过滤和
    74	Graph 邻接缩小候选集，再回读【1】～【11】原文。只补充受影响小节，不无差别重写初稿。
    75	
    76	索引中的 `unknown`、`needs_review` 或无候选不等于“资料不存在”。完成有界检索后仍冲突的来源进入 `PRESERVED_CONFLICT`：保留所有版本并冻结禁止声明，不自动选边，也不创建人工请求。资料快照内无法补齐的事实进入 `SNAPSHOT_LIMITATION`，禁止把缺失值补写为事实。
    77	
    78	## STEP3 — Multi-pass Validation
    79	
    80	读取 [`references/step3-validation.md`](references/step3-validation.md)，依次完成：
    81	
    82	1. 原文与定位校核；
    83	2. 实体、时间、单位和状态语义校核；
    84	3. 跨资料重复、版本和冲突校核；
    85	4. 章节结构、证据覆盖和确定性聚合校核。
    86	
    87	只有通过校核的事实进入 `chapter-1-facts.json`。索引 metadata 不得进入该结构化事实集。每个 `PRESERVED_CONFLICT` 必须携带双方来源、受影响声明和机器可验的降级动作；当报告没有采用冲突单值且所有限制可见时，冲突不阻断进入下一阶段。
    88	
    89	```bash
    90	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/validate_chapter_one_step3.py \
    91	  --candidate "<STEP2/chapter-1.md>" \
    92	  --evidence "<STEP2/chapter-1-evidence.json>" \
    93	  --dispositions "<STEP2/gap-conflict-dispositions.json>" \
    94	  --reference-root docs/collaboration/reference \
    95	  --facts-output "<STEP3/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
    96	  --report-output "<STEP3/validation-report.json>" \
    97	  --experiment-id "<STEP3 experiment>" \
    98	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP2 experiment>"
    99	```
   100	
   101	若六列表的合并单元格展开、数量或频次映射失败，必须先回到独立 STEP2 correction child；不得在 STEP4 静默修表。
   102	
   103	## STEP4 — Final Markdown
   104	
   105	读取 [`references/step4-final-markdown.md`](references/step4-final-markdown.md)。只从通过 STEP3 的
   106	`chapter-1-facts.json` 和最终 EvidenceRef 生成 Markdown；不重新搜索资料，不在生成阶段裁决冲突。
   107	
   108	本阶段唯一用户可见产物是最终 `chapter-1.md`。DOCX/PDF 暂不进入范围。
   109	
   110	```bash
   111	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/render_chapter_one.py \
   112	  --facts "<STEP3/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   113	  --output "<STEP4/chapter-1.md>" \
   114	  --experiment-id "<STEP4 experiment>" \
   115	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP3 experiment>"
   116	
   117	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/validate_chapter_one_final.py \
   118	  --facts "<STEP4/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   119	  --evidence "<STEP4/chapter-1-evidence.json>" \
   120	  --dispositions "<STEP2/gap-conflict-dispositions.json>" \
   121	  --step3-report "<STEP3/validation-report.json>" \
   122	  --markdown "<STEP4/chapter-1.md>" \
   123	  --output "<STEP4/validation-summary.json>" \
   124	  --experiment-id "<STEP4 experiment>" \
   125	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP3 experiment>"
   126	```
   127	
   128	审计型最终稿必须由 renderer 从 STEP3 facts 字节级重放；不得复制候选稿后手工追加事实。没有可交付图件时省略图片占位，不保留未解释引用。
   129	
   130	## STEP5 — Formal Report Normalization
   131	
   132	读取 [`references/step5-formal-report.md`](references/step5-formal-report.md)。只允许把 STEP4 审计型正文转换为正式报告措辞：工程事实直接陈述，EvidenceRef 仍保留在段末，实验元数据和来源叙述移出用户可见 Markdown。
   133	
   134	正式措辞包必须逐一映射全部 `fact_id`；renderer 只装配经过版本化的措辞、冻结表格和限制处置。validator 必须证明数字/日期 token 没有新增或丢失、EvidenceRef 集合未变、30×6 表格状态未变、5 项限制与 3 项冲突动作仍可见，以及“根据/参考/报告记载/提及”等禁用研究措辞为 0。
   135	
   136	STEP5 不得借文体优化补入 Template 示例事实、重新搜索资料、选择冲突值或形成安全结论。正式 Markdown 通过后状态为 `FORMALIZED_WITH_LIMITATIONS`；DOCX/PDF 仍不在范围。
   137	
   138	```bash
   139	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/render_chapter_one_formal.py \
   140	  --facts "<STEP5/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   141	  --wording "<STEP5/formal-wording.json>" \
   142	  --output "<STEP5/chapter-1.md>"
   143	
   144	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/validate_chapter_one_formal.py \
   145	  --facts "<STEP5/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   146	  --wording "<STEP5/formal-wording.json>" \
   147	  --evidence "<STEP5/chapter-1-evidence.json>" \
   148	  --dispositions "<STEP2/gap-conflict-dispositions.json>" \
   149	  --parent-validation "<STEP4/validation-summary.json>" \
   150	  --parent-build "<STEP4/build-manifest.json>" \
   151	  --markdown "<STEP5/chapter-1.md>" \
   152	  --output "<STEP5/formalization-report.json>" \
   153	  --experiment-id "<STEP5 experiment>" \
   154	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP4 experiment>"
   155	```
   156	
   157	## Global Stop Rules
   158	
   159	- 工程实体、资料版本或来源状态无法界定时停止提升事实；
   160	- 关键事实没有 EvidenceRef 时保留稳定 Gap；有界检索后仍缺证则输出 `> 资料限制`，不创建人工请求；
   161	- 方案、实施、复查和当前状态不能互相替代；
   162	- 设计量、埋设量、接入量、在测量和未知数量不能混用；
   163	- 正负号规则不得从历史测值或行业习惯反推；
   164	- 不自动覆盖冲突来源，也不请求人工裁决；冲突必须保留全部来源并排除单值声明；
   165	- 不生成可靠性、完备性、安全性或稳定性评价结论。
   166	
   167	## Status Handoff
   168	
   169	每次交付至少报告：当前阶段、已完成章节、Evidence/Gap/Conflict 数量、非交互处置、已运行校核、blocker、下一 gate
   170	和授权边界。不得用“基本完成”代替明确状态。
   171

    48	当前阶段的 gate 未通过时不得进入下一阶段。每个后续实验目录必须声明 `parent_experiment_id`，不得覆盖
    49	前一阶段产物。
    50	
    51	## 前置阶段 — Build Index and Graph
    52	
    53	调用 `$build-reference-filemap`，范围固定为允许检索的【1】～【11】。该阶段只建立候选路由层：
    54	
    55	- technical filemap 冻结路径、哈希、格式和结构；
    56	- Excel 记录每个 Sheet 的结构和物理前 10 行；
    57	- `$extract-reference-metadata-tags` 以一文件一模型输入提取 `title`、`summary` 和 typed raw tags；
    58	- 全量扫描结束后统一归并同义 tag，并建立实体层级 registry；
    59	- SQLite FTS 和 tag Graph 支持全文、canonical tag、实体层级与相关文件查询；
    60	- metadata 不要求逐字段 locator，查询结果必须在 STEP2 回读原文件后才能转成 EvidenceRef。
    61	
    62	索引和 Graph gate 未通过时可以先完成 STEP1，但不得开始 STEP2。
    63	
    64	## STEP1 — Draft from 【0】
    65	
    66	读取 [`references/step1-primary-draft.md`](references/step1-primary-draft.md)，仅使用【0】生成第一章初稿。
    67	为每个固定小节整理“可写事实、EvidenceRef、Gap、Conflict”，为 Gap 分配稳定 ID，并形成第二轮待办。
    68	
    69	STEP1 允许以 `PASSED_WITH_GAPS` 交付；Gap 进入后续机器检索，不创建人工输入请求，也不得为了看似完整而跨目录补写或使用 Template 示例事实。
    70	
    71	## STEP2 — Gap-driven Supplement
    72	
    73	读取 [`references/step2-gap-supplement.md`](references/step2-gap-supplement.md)。逐个 Gap 使用 catalog 过滤和
    74	Graph 邻接缩小候选集，再回读【1】～【11】原文。只补充受影响小节，不无差别重写初稿。
    75	
    76	索引中的 `unknown`、`needs_review` 或无候选不等于“资料不存在”。完成有界检索后仍冲突的来源进入 `PRESERVED_CONFLICT`：保留所有版本并冻结禁止声明，不自动选边，也不创建人工请求。资料快照内无法补齐的事实进入 `SNAPSHOT_LIMITATION`，禁止把缺失值补写为事实。
    77	
    78	## STEP3 — Multi-pass Validation
    79	
    80	读取 [`references/step3-validation.md`](references/step3-validation.md)，依次完成：
    81	
    82	1. 原文与定位校核；
    83	2. 实体、时间、单位和状态语义校核；
    84	3. 跨资料重复、版本和冲突校核；
    85	4. 章节结构、证据覆盖和确定性聚合校核。
    86	
    87	只有通过校核的事实进入 `chapter-1-facts.json`。索引 metadata 不得进入该结构化事实集。每个 `PRESERVED_CONFLICT` 必须携带双方来源、受影响声明和机器可验的降级动作；当报告没有采用冲突单值且所有限制可见时，冲突不阻断进入下一阶段。
    88	
    89	```bash
    90	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/validate_chapter_one_step3.py \
    91	  --candidate "<STEP2/chapter-1.md>" \
    92	  --evidence "<STEP2/chapter-1-evidence.json>" \
    93	  --dispositions "<STEP2/gap-conflict-dispositions.json>" \
    94	  --reference-root docs/collaboration/reference \
    95	  --facts-output "<STEP3/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
    96	  --report-output "<STEP3/validation-report.json>" \
    97	  --experiment-id "<STEP3 experiment>" \
    98	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP2 experiment>"
    99	```
   100	
   101	若六列表的合并单元格展开、数量或频次映射失败，必须先回到独立 STEP2 correction child；不得在 STEP4 静默修表。
   102	
   103	## STEP4 — Final Markdown
   104	
   105	读取 [`references/step4-final-markdown.md`](references/step4-final-markdown.md)。只从通过 STEP3 的
   106	`chapter-1-facts.json` 和最终 EvidenceRef 生成 Markdown；不重新搜索资料，不在生成阶段裁决冲突。
   107	
   108	本阶段唯一用户可见产物是最终 `chapter-1.md`。DOCX/PDF 暂不进入范围。
   109	
   110	```bash
   111	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/render_chapter_one.py \
   112	  --facts "<STEP3/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   113	  --output "<STEP4/chapter-1.md>" \
   114	  --experiment-id "<STEP4 experiment>" \
   115	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP3 experiment>"
   116	
   117	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/validate_chapter_one_final.py \
   118	  --facts "<STEP4/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   119	  --evidence "<STEP4/chapter-1-evidence.json>" \
   120	  --dispositions "<STEP2/gap-conflict-dispositions.json>" \
   121	  --step3-report "<STEP3/validation-report.json>" \
   122	  --markdown "<STEP4/chapter-1.md>" \
   123	  --output "<STEP4/validation-summary.json>" \
   124	  --experiment-id "<STEP4 experiment>" \
   125	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP3 experiment>"
   126	```
   127	
   128	审计型最终稿必须由 renderer 从 STEP3 facts 字节级重放；不得复制候选稿后手工追加事实。没有可交付图件时省略图片占位，不保留未解释引用。
   129	
   130	## STEP5 — Formal Report Normalization
   131	
   132	读取 [`references/step5-formal-report.md`](references/step5-formal-report.md)。只允许把 STEP4 审计型正文转换为正式报告措辞：工程事实直接陈述，EvidenceRef 仍保留在段末，实验元数据和来源叙述移出用户可见 Markdown。
   133	
   134	正式措辞包必须逐一映射全部 `fact_id`；renderer 只装配经过版本化的措辞、冻结表格和限制处置。validator 必须证明数字/日期 token 没有新增或丢失、EvidenceRef 集合未变、30×6 表格状态未变、5 项限制与 3 项冲突动作仍可见，以及“根据/参考/报告记载/提及”等禁用研究措辞为 0。
   135	
   136	STEP5 不得借文体优化补入 Template 示例事实、重新搜索资料、选择冲突值或形成安全结论。正式 Markdown 通过后状态为 `FORMALIZED_WITH_LIMITATIONS`；DOCX/PDF 仍不在范围。
   137	
   138	```bash
   139	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/render_chapter_one_formal.py \
   140	  --facts "<STEP5/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   141	  --wording "<STEP5/formal-wording.json>" \
   142	  --output "<STEP5/chapter-1.md>"
   143	
   144	python3 .agents/skills/report-chapter-one-generation/scripts/validate_chapter_one_formal.py \
   145	  --facts "<STEP5/chapter-1-facts.json>" \
   146	  --wording "<STEP5/formal-wording.json>" \
   147	  --evidence "<STEP5/chapter-1-evidence.json>" \
   148	  --dispositions "<STEP2/gap-conflict-dispositions.json>" \
   149	  --parent-validation "<STEP4/validation-summary.json>" \
   150	  --parent-build "<STEP4/build-manifest.json>" \
   151	  --markdown "<STEP5/chapter-1.md>" \
   152	  --output "<STEP5/formalization-report.json>" \
   153	  --experiment-id "<STEP5 experiment>" \
   154	  --parent-experiment-id "<STEP4 experiment>"
   155	```
   156	
   157	## Global Stop Rules
   158	
   159	- 工程实体、资料版本或来源状态无法界定时停止提升事实；
   160	- 关键事实没有 EvidenceRef 时保留稳定 Gap；有界检索后仍缺证则输出 `> 资料限制`，不创建人工请求；
   161	- 方案、实施、复查和当前状态不能互相替代；
   162	- 设计量、埋设量、接入量、在测量和未知数量不能混用；
   163	- 正负号规则不得从历史测值或行业习惯反推；
   164	- 不自动覆盖冲突来源，也不请求人工裁决；冲突必须保留全部来源并排除单值声明；
   165	- 不生成可靠性、完备性、安全性或稳定性评价结论。
   166	
   167	## Status Handoff
   168	
   169	每次交付至少报告：当前阶段、已完成章节、Evidence/Gap/Conflict 数量、非交互处置、已运行校核、blocker、下一 gate
   170	和授权边界。不得用“基本完成”代替明确状态。

68	Changing confirmed expected behavior requires a new revision entry and reopens
    69	any affected frozen Spec.
    70	
    71	### Spec lifecycle
    72	
    73	```text
    74	DRAFT -> FROZEN -> IMPLEMENTATION_ACTIVE -> VALIDATION_ACTIVE
    75	      -> VALIDATED | REJECTED | SUPERSEDED
    76	```
    77	
    78	A Spec is `FROZEN` only when its required contracts and decisions are resolved.
    79	Changing a frozen public contract returns it to `DRAFT` or creates a superseding
    80	Spec; record the transition in the Feature changelog.
    81	
    82	### ADR lifecycle
    83	
    84	```text
    85	PROPOSED -> ACCEPTED | REJECTED
    86	ACCEPTED -> SUPERSEDED | DEPRECATED
    87	```
    88	
    89	Do not rewrite an accepted ADR to express a new decision. Create a new ADR and
    90	link `supersedes` / `superseded_by` in both records.
    91	
    92	## 4. Feature creation gate
    93	
    94	A new Feature requires:
    95	
    96	- an independent durable owner under the Feature granularity rules;
    97	- problem, actor/outcome, scope, and non-goals;
    98	- expected behavior and measurable/observable acceptance;
    99	- constraints, NFRs, safety/authorization, and stop rules;
   100	- a README current-state route and changelog;
   101	- registration in `docs/feature/INDEX.md` and `docs/OVERVIEW.md`.
   102	
   103	Creating a Feature does not automatically require an ADR. Create the first Spec
   104	only when implementation-relevant contracts are known or need to be frozen.
   105	
   106	## 5. Spec freeze gate
   107	
   108	A Spec may become `FROZEN` only when applicable fields are complete:
   109	
   110	- requirements version/reference;
   111	- scope and non-goals;
   112	- accepted blocking ADR references;
   113	- public API, schema, artifact, and compatibility contracts;
   114	- data flow, state machine, mutable-state owner, and serialization boundaries;
   115	- module responsibilities, interfaces, dependency direction, and reuse boundary;
   116	- security, privacy, authorization, and evidence boundaries;
   117	- migration and backward-compatibility behavior;
   118	- validation matrix with seams, tests, evidence, and pass criteria;
   119	- rollout, rollback, stop conditions, and failure handling;
   120	- zero blocking open questions;
   121	- explicit docs-only versus implementation authorization.
   122	
   123	Not every Spec needs every section. Mark a section `Not applicable` with a
   124	reason rather than silently omitting a risk-bearing category.
   125	
   126	A frozen Spec is `IMPLEMENTATION_READY` only when code entry points, file
   127	budgets, test owners, next gate, and separate implementation authorization are
   128	also clear.
   129	
   130	## 6. ADR trigger and gate
   131	
   132	Create an ADR when a decision is difficult to reverse, surprising without its
   133	context, and based on a real trade-off. Strong candidates include system/Feature
   134	boundaries, data ownership, persistent storage, public protocol, deployment
   135	topology, security model, and irreversible migration.
   136	
   137	A blocking ADR must be `ACCEPTED` before a dependent Spec becomes `FROZEN`.
   138	`PROPOSED` ADRs contain a recommendation, not an accepted decision. `REJECTED`
   139	ADRs remain discoverable so the same option is not repeatedly reconsidered.
   140	
   141	## 7. Patch rules
   142	
   143	For an existing Feature:
   144	
   145	- patch `requirements.md` only when expected behavior changes;
   146	- create a new Spec for a new bounded implementation change;
   147	- do not overwrite a validated or superseded Spec;
   148	- create an ADR only for ADR-worthy choices, not every design detail;
   149	- keep current implementation claims in README aligned with code;
   150	- append state transitions to `changelog.md`;
   151	- route completed historical Specs according to the repository archive policy.
   152	
   153	## 8. Progressive disclosure
   154	
   155	Default reading remains:
   156	
   157	```text
   158	AGENTS -> OVERVIEW -> Feature INDEX -> Feature README/requirements
   159	```
   160	
   161	Read an active Spec only for implementation, review, validation, or contract
   162	questions. Read an ADR only when its scope affects the current decision. Do not
   163	load every historical Spec or ADR.
   164	
   165	## 9. Confirmation and authorization
   166	
   167	A user confirmation freezes the described product/engineering boundary; it does
   168	not grant implementation, deployment, execution, publication, or destructive
   169	actions. When `add-idea` faithfully materializes the confirmed boundary, change
   170	the affected requirements revision from `DRAFT` to `CONFIRMED` and update the
   171	Feature README route/status in the same write. Store decision authority and date
   172	only when the project can name them accurately. Never invent an approver identity.

    56	若请求仍是未成形的 idea，缺少 owner、scope、acceptance 或 route-affecting decisions，先使用
    57	`add-idea` 完成逐题 Grill、shared-understanding confirmation、Feature owner 选择和 requirements/Spec/ADR
    58	物化。本技能只消费其确认后的内部合同，不重复访谈，也不把 idea 直接推进代码实施。
    59	
    60	若用户已经提供清晰边界且 owning Feature 与 active Spec 可定位，继续本流程。
    61	
    62	### 阶段 0：解析主线路线与认知层级
    63	
    64	先从 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 解析唯一 `CURRENT DEVELOPMENT MAINLINE`，再进入 owning INDEX/README。
    65	若 README 存在 `MAINLINE-ROUTE` manifest，以它作为当前路线 overlay；稳定依赖仍由 development plan
    66	持有，child GOAL 只持有局部状态。
    67	
    68	创建、变更、验证或汇报路线时，加载并遵循
    69	[mainline-route-contract.md](../progressive-disclosure-docs/references/mainline-route-contract.md)
    70	作为共享 schema 与认知披露合同；
    71	本 Skill 继续负责端到端编排，不另建路线管理 Skill。
    72	
    73	把用户语言规范化为稳定 route mutation：
    74	
    75	- `A -> B`：顺序依赖；`A || B`：并行；`[A || B] -> J`：汇合；
    76	- insert、pause、drop、replace：插入、暂停、移除或替换；
    77	- node ID 稳定且不可复用，只供机器使用；每个节点必须另有语义化模块/里程碑名称。
    78	
    79	上述字母只用于内部规范化。向用户复述理解、汇报路线或进度时，必须把节点映射成模块/里程碑
    80	名称，不输出 `M0`、`M3C`、`A/BC` 或 raw node ID，除非用户明确要求内部标识。
    81	
    82	然后分类：
    83	
    84	- 仅本轮先做哪一项 → session plan，不改 durable docs；
    85	- 跨会话 current focus 变化 → owning README route manifest；
    86	- 节点、依赖、并行、汇合、插入、暂停或删除变化 → development plan + README + changelog；
    87	- 当前 Feature 切换 → OVERVIEW 指针 + 新旧 owner role/README + changelog。
    88	
    89	只有解释会改变依赖、合同、证据含义或授权时才询问用户；否则简短声明理解后继续。
    90	
    91	### 阶段 1：开发前扫描 owning docs
    92	
    93	先检查：
    94	
    95	- `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
    96	- `docs/feature/INDEX.md`
    97	- owning module 的 `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
    98	- owning module 的 `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`（存在且任务涉及期望行为 / bug 时）
    99	- active `docs/feature/<module>/specs/SPEC-*.md`（contract-affecting implementation 时）
   100	- blocking Feature-local ADR 与相关 system ADR（只读当前 Spec 引用的 decision）
   101	- `docs/reference/INDEX.md`
   102	- 可能相关的 `docs/reference/*.md`
   103	- `docs/reference/code-organization.md`
   104	- owning GOAL / README 的 current-state section — completed、pending、blockers、next validation gate 和 evidence
   105	- 若任务来自外部团队：`docs/collaboration/<case-id>/INDEX.md`、问题包版本和外部方案 provenance
   106	
   107	优先用 `Glob` 找文件，再用 `Read` 读取候选文档。
   108	
   109	匹配时重点看：
   110	
   111	- 模块名
   112	- 功能名
   113	- API 名称
   114	- 关键词
   115	- 最近 changelog
   116	
   117	如果找到相关文档：
   118	
   119	- 把 `AGENTS.md` 和用户明确授权视为安全与权限真值
   120	- 把 owning `requirements.md` / confirmed contract 视为 expected behavior 真值
   121	- 把 active frozen Spec 视为本次 bounded implementation contract
   122	- 把 accepted ADR 视为 durable architecture rationale；`proposed` ADR 不能授权依赖它的实现
   123	- 把当前代码视为 implemented behavior 真值
   124	- 把不可变 artifact / ledger / gate report 视为 evidence 真值
   125	- 把 owning README 视为上述事实的当前快照，不用它替代合同、代码或证据
   126	- 任何冲突都必须分类为 contract gap、implementation gap、evidence gap 或 stale summary，不得用一层静默覆盖另一层
   127	- 外部 proposal 只作为 recommendation/provenance；只有 adoption matrix 中 `ACCEPTED` 或
   128	  `MODIFIED`，且已转译为 confirmed requirements、conditional accepted ADR、frozen Spec 与
   129	  owning README current-state link 的条目才可能进入后续实施门
   130	
   131	如果没找到相关文档：
   132	
   133	- 新 idea 或 contract-affecting 功能先进入 `add-idea`；不得因缺 owner 而直接编码
   134	- 已有明确 owner 的 trivial 局部修复可直接定向分析/实施
   135	- 不要求为无合同影响的 trivial 修改强制创建 Spec

1	# Code Organization
     2	
     3	> 上级：[INDEX.md](INDEX.md)
     4	> Feature 详细设计：[`../feature/report-generation/design.md`](../feature/report-generation/design.md)
     5	
     6	## Directory Owners
     7	
     8	```text
     9	apps/
    10	  api/              HTTP transport and dependency wiring
    11	  worker/           local worker lifecycle, lease and dispatch
    12	packages/
    13	  domain/           framework-free Job, monitoring, analysis and report semantics
    14	  contracts/        REST, port, event and artifact schemas
    15	  agentcore/        provider-neutral port, fake adapter and OpenAI adapter
    16	  orchestrator/     phase machine, gates, retries and human intervention
    17	  research/         local source manifest, parsers, normalization, retrieval and recipes
    18	  evidence/         EvidenceRef, ProjectKnowledgeSnapshot and lineage
    19	  renderer/         DOCX, Audit JSON and debug Markdown artifacts
    20	  policy/           local tool and data authorization
    21	  observability/    job timeline, traces, metrics and eval hooks
    22	  prompts/          versioned narrative and reviewer prompts
    23	templates/
    24	  safety-monitoring-monthly/v1/
    25	                    versioned template config and DOCX master
    26	projects/
    27	  <project-id>/      reviewable ProjectProfile and source hints
    28	runtime/             gitignored SQLite, normalized data, charts and artifacts
    29	infra/               local and deployment configuration
    30	tests/               unit, contract, integration and eval suites
    31	```
    32	
    33	`templates/`、`projects/` 和 `runtime/` 在业务实现切片中创建；当前 scaffold 尚未包含这些目录。
    34	
    35	## Package Rules
    36	
    37	- 一个稳定责任对应一个 package；禁止创建无边界 `utils/common/helpers`。
    38	- `domain` 和 `contracts` 不依赖 apps、provider SDK、数据库、模板或格式库。
    39	- provider adapter 只放在 `packages/agentcore`。
    40	- parser、标准化和 AnalysisRecipe 放在 `packages/research`，但 parser 与 recipe 必须分目录并通过稳定模型解耦。
    41	- `orchestrator` 只依赖 port，不导入 OpenAI、SQLite、openpyxl、xlrd、docxtpl 或 python-docx。
    42	- `renderer` 不读取原始资料、不计算监测指标、不调用 Agent。
    43	- `prompts` 只持有角色提示和 schema binding，不持有阈值、计算公式、运行状态或项目私有资料。
    44	- 跨包共享只通过 domain/contracts/显式 port；禁止导入另一个包的内部路径。
    45	- 新 package 必须同时加入 workspace、OVERVIEW、owner README 和 scaffold validator。
    46	- 手写文件达到 800 行触发拆分评审，1000 行为硬上限。
    47	
    48	## Expected Internal Layout
    49	
    50	```text
    51	packages/research/src/reportagent_research/
    52	  manifest/
    53	  parsers/
    54	    xls.py
    55	    xlsx.py
    56	    doc.py
    57	    docx.py
    58	  normalization/
    59	  retrieval/
    60	  recipes/
    61	    monthly_change.py
    62	    period_extrema.py
    63	    threshold_comparison.py
    64	    data_quality.py
    65	    environment_monthly.py
    66	
    67	packages/orchestrator/src/reportagent_orchestrator/
    68	  state_machine.py
    69	  handlers/
    70	  gates/
    71	  services/
    72	  ports.py
    73	
    74	packages/renderer/src/reportagent_renderer/
    75	  docx/
    76	  audit_json.py
    77	  debug_markdown.py
    78	  ports.py
    79	```
    80	
    81	这些是责任路由，不要求在第一个 commit 一次性创建全部叶子。
    82	
    83	## Test Ownership
    84	
    85	- `tests/unit`：domain invariants、Recipe、rounding 和 source normalization；
    86	- `tests/contract`：AgentCore、parser、repository、renderer ports；
    87	- `tests/integration`：Job 状态机、SQLite 恢复、DOCX 和历史重放；
    88	- `tests/eval`：Agent 结构化输出、技术叙述和 reviewer 行为；
    89	- Golden fixtures 必须与真实私有资料隔离，提交前确认是否允许进入仓库。

# ReportAgent

面向本地资料包的模板驱动报告生成应用。系统目标是把项目知识、周期数据、确定性分析、受控 Agent 技术叙述和 DOCX 渲染组织为可审计、可恢复的 Report Job。当前已冻结稳定版安全监测月报 MVP 架构，但尚未实现业务代码。

## 快速开始

```bash
uv lock
python3 scripts/check_scaffold.py
python3 scripts/check_docs_links.py
```

## Monorepo

```text
apps/          API 与 worker 薄入口的预留位置
packages/      domain、contracts、port、adapter 与 orchestration owner 边界
templates/     版本化报告模板与 DOCX master（实施阶段创建）
projects/      可审查项目配置（实施阶段创建）
infra/         本地依赖与部署配置（当前仅冻结边界）
tests/         unit、contract、integration、eval 验证层
docs/          feature SSOT、稳定 reference、来源记录与归档
.agents/       repo-local harness skills
```

项目地图、已冻结边界与后续实现入口从 [`docs/OVERVIEW.md`](docs/OVERVIEW.md) 开始读取。

300	| 2 | 功能实现**完成后**，这个文件是否仍然需要**长期维护**（随代码演进持续更新）？ | 是 → SSOT | 否（一次性分析/总结/批注）→ 不持久化；有历史价值时明确归档 |
   301	| 3 | 文件属于**模块功能描述**还是**运行/测试/验证方式**？ | 模块功能 → `docs/feature/<module>/` | 运行/测试方式 → `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md` |
   302	| 4 | 文件记录的是接口/字段/状态/枚举的**稳定契约**吗？ | 是 → SSOT，同步更新 `docs/reference/interfaces.md` | 否 → 属于不稳定草稿或执行上下文 |
   303	| 5 | 文件描述的是**预期行为/验收条件**、**冻结实施合同**、**架构决策理由**还是**当前实现状态**？ | requirements → `requirements.md`；实施合同 → Spec；持久决策 → ADR；当前状态 → `README.md`/`INDEX.md` | 都不是 → 非 SSOT；临时内容不落盘，有历史价值时明确归档 |
   304	
   305	### 典型非 SSOT 文件去向
   306	
   307	| 文件类型 | 典型示例 | 正确去向 |
   308	|----------|---------|---------|
   309	| Gap analysis / 差异分析 | `agent-io-gap-analysis.md`（模块A与模块B的接口差异） | 稳定差异并入 owning requirements/README；临时内容不落盘 |
   310	| 一次性总结/总结批注 | `agent-http-call-summary.md`（某次对接后的总结记录） | 关键内容并入 SSOT；仅有历史价值时明确归档 |
   311	| 测试运行方式 | `test.md` 描述如何启动服务、运行 E2E | `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md` |
   312	| 临时执行顺序 | 不含稳定结论的本轮步骤、检查项 | 会话计划；不创建仓库文件 |
   313	| 中间 review 产物 | Codex review 原始输出、一次性 lint 报告 | `docs/archive/<module>-reviews/` |
   314	| 临时设计草稿 | 未经评审的 schema 草稿 | 评审通过后按 SSOT 格式写入 doc，草稿废弃 |
   315	
   316	### 目录自检（交叉校验）
   317	
   318	每次创建或修改 `docs/feature/<module>/` 后，agent 必须对该目录执行一次自检：
   319	
   320	1. 列出目录下所有 `.md` 文件
   321	2. 对每个文件应用上述判定流程
   322	3. 如果发现非 SSOT 文件，立即移出；临时内容不持久化，有历史价值时明确归档
   323	4. 确认每个文件的 `> 上级：` 反链指向正确的父文档
   324	5. 确认 `docs/feature/INDEX.md` 的路由表已同步更新（新增、迁移或删除均需同步）
   325	6. 确认 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 的模块表和反链无需增补
   326	
   327	> **失败模式**：某个 feature 目录下出现 gap analysis、测试运行方式、一次性总结等非 SSOT 文件 → 说明上一步的 SSOT 判定被跳过，需要立即纠正。
   328	
   329	### External collaboration exception
   330	
   331	External problem packages and proposals are durable provenance records, not system SSOT. They may
   332	live only under `docs/collaboration/<case-id>/`, never loose inside an owning Feature. Route creation,
   333	proposal receipt, adoption, translation and closure through the repo-local
   334	`external-collaboration-workflow` Skill; do not duplicate that workflow here.
   335	
   336	- `problem-statement.md` is internally owned and versioned after issuance.
   337	- `external-proposal.md` is externally owned; internal agents preserve the source and do not rewrite
   338	  it into an internal design.
   339	- `INDEX.md` records version binding and item-level `ACCEPTED` / `MODIFIED` / `REJECTED` / `DEFERRED`
   340	  decisions, then links each accepted item to an internal SSOT target and validation evidence.
   341	- No implementation starts from an external proposal. First translate accepted content into confirmed
   342	  requirements, conditional accepted ADRs, a frozen Spec, and owning README links; progress remains
   343	  in owning README/changelog/evidence.
   344	
   345	## Large Proposal Decomposition
   346	
   347	Design proposals (under `docs/feature/<module>/proposals/`) often carry three different audiences:
   348	
   349	| Audience | What they want | What hurts them |
   350	|----------|----------------|-----------------|
   351	| Reviewer / decision-maker | "Why, big direction, key decisions, risks" | Drowning in schema details and SQL DDL |

   303	| 5 | 文件描述的是**预期行为/验收条件**、**冻结实施合同**、**架构决策理由**还是**当前实现状态**？ | requirements → `requirements.md`；实施合同 → Spec；持久决策 → ADR；当前状态 → `README.md`/`INDEX.md` | 都不是 → 非 SSOT；临时内容不落盘，有历史价值时明确归档 |
   304	
   305	### 典型非 SSOT 文件去向
   306	
   307	| 文件类型 | 典型示例 | 正确去向 |
   308	|----------|---------|---------|
   309	| Gap analysis / 差异分析 | `agent-io-gap-analysis.md`（模块A与模块B的接口差异） | 稳定差异并入 owning requirements/README；临时内容不落盘 |
   310	| 一次性总结/总结批注 | `agent-http-call-summary.md`（某次对接后的总结记录） | 关键内容并入 SSOT；仅有历史价值时明确归档 |
   311	| 测试运行方式 | `test.md` 描述如何启动服务、运行 E2E | `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md` |
   312	| 临时执行顺序 | 不含稳定结论的本轮步骤、检查项 | 会话计划；不创建仓库文件 |
   313	| 中间 review 产物 | Codex review 原始输出、一次性 lint 报告 | `docs/archive/<module>-reviews/` |
   314	| 临时设计草稿 | 未经评审的 schema 草稿 | 评审通过后按 SSOT 格式写入 doc，草稿废弃 |
   315	
   316	### 目录自检（交叉校验）
   317	
   318	每次创建或修改 `docs/feature/<module>/` 后，agent 必须对该目录执行一次自检：
   319	
   320	1. 列出目录下所有 `.md` 文件
   321	2. 对每个文件应用上述判定流程
   322	3. 如果发现非 SSOT 文件，立即移出；临时内容不持久化，有历史价值时明确归档
   323	4. 确认每个文件的 `> 上级：` 反链指向正确的父文档
   324	5. 确认 `docs/feature/INDEX.md` 的路由表已同步更新（新增、迁移或删除均需同步）
   325	6. 确认 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 的模块表和反链无需增补

   331	External problem packages and proposals are durable provenance records, not system SSOT. They may

   337	- `external-proposal.md` is externally owned; internal agents preserve the source and do not rewrite
   338	  it into an internal design.

   340	  decisions, then links each accepted item to an internal SSOT target and validation evidence.
   341	- No implementation starts from an external proposal. First translate accepted content into confirmed
   342	  requirements, conditional accepted ADRs, a frozen Spec, and owning README links; progress remains
   343	  in owning README/changelog/evidence.

   345	## Large Proposal Decomposition

   347	Design proposals (under `docs/feature/<module>/proposals/`) often carry three different audiences:

   349	| Audience | What they want | What hurts them |
   350	|----------|----------------|-----------------|
   351	| Reviewer / decision-maker | "Why, big direction, key decisions, risks" | Drowning in schema details and SQL DDL |
   352	| Implementer | "Full schema, DDL, pseudocode, integration points" | Hunting through high-level prose to find concrete spec |
   353	| Progress tracker | "Task matrix, stage gates, week-by-week path" | Reading the entire proposal each time |

380	A proposal is not an implementation contract. Before implementation, accepted
   381	content must be translated into requirements, accepted ADRs, and a frozen Spec;
   382	then archive or mark the proposal superseded according to repository policy.
   383	
   384	### Codex review archival
   385	
   386	Once a review is consumed (findings inlined into design/spec), move the review file to `docs/archive/<module>-reviews/` with a versioned name (e.g. `review-<topic>-v1.md` → `review-<topic>-v2.md` → `review-<topic>-v3-synthesis.md`). Keep the top-of-file frontmatter pointing back to the **current authoritative** location, but preserve in-body line-number references to the version that was reviewed.
   387	
   388	### Example
   389	
   390	`docs/feature/ai-evaluation/proposals/oracle-batch-verdict/` (created 2026-05-14):
   391	- v3 single-file was 995 lines, deemed "too much implementation spec for a proposal"
   392	- decomposed into README (36) + design.md (286) + spec.md (614) + acceptance.md (202)
   393	- 4 historical codex reviews moved to `docs/archive/ai-evaluation-reviews/review-oracle-batch-verdict-{v1,v2,v3-synthesis}.md`
   394	
   395	## docs/reference/INDEX.md, docs/collaboration/INDEX.md & docs/archive/INDEX.md
   396	
   397	**Reference**: stable technical facts (architecture, interfaces, runbooks, external API). Not feature work logs.
   398	
   399	**Collaboration**: source records exchanged with external teams plus internal adoption routing. Not
   400	requirements, implementation truth, authorization, or a parallel progress tracker.
   401	
   402	**Archive**: completed plans, bugfix notes, RCA, old changelogs, deprecated proposals. Default: **do not read**. Only enter when task explicitly requires historical context.
   403	
   404	Both must include agent routing instructions and forbid full reads.
   405	
   406	## Durable Progress Rule
   407	
   408	```text
   409	README.md / INDEX.md explains what the module is, its current implemented state,
   410	current API inventory, known gaps, completed work, pending work, blockers, the
   411	next validation gate, and routing.
   412	requirements.md explains expected product/business behavior and acceptance.
   413	Specs explain bounded implementation contracts. ADRs explain durable
   414	architectural choices and their trade-offs. Stable evidence lives in owning
   415	docs or append-only artifacts. Transient
   416	sequencing stays in the session planning surface and is not persisted as a
   417	parallel control plane.
   418	```
   419	
   420	## Frontmatter Convention
   421	
   422	For feature, archive, and RCA docs:
   423	
   424	```yaml
   425	---
   426	type: feature | bugfix | rca | changelog | plan | reference | archive
   427	scope: backend | frontend | fullstack | docs | ops
   428	module: module-name
   429	date: YYYY-MM-DD
   430	status: active | implemented | deprecated | archived | draft
   431	role: current-mainline | separate-planned | supporting | historical
   432	lifecycle: proposed | active | maintenance | deprecated | retired | abandoned
   433	requirements_status: draft | confirmed | superseded
   434	spec_status: none | draft | frozen | implementation_active | validation_active | validated | rejected | superseded
   435	decision_status: clear | proposed_blocking | accepted | rejected | superseded
   436	evidence_status: contract_only | source_record | engineering | discovery | validation | accepted | rejected
   437	authorization: project-specific-boundary
   438	last_verified: YYYY-MM-DD
   439	next_gate: stable-gate-id
   440	keywords: [short, searchable, terms]
   441	read_by_default: false
   442	---
   443	```
   444	
   445	- `OVERVIEW.md` and `INDEX.md` do not need frontmatter unless project already enforces it.
   446	- Large detailed docs: `read_by_default: false`.
   447	- Historical docs: `status: archived` or under `docs/archive/`.
   448	
   449	## Migration Recipe
   450	
   451	1. Inventory Markdown files excluding runtime/build directories.
   452	2. Identify current entrypoints: `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `docs/OVERVIEW.md`.
   453	3. Classify docs into: requirements / Feature current state / Specs / ADRs / reference / archive.
   454	4. Create or update: `OVERVIEW.md`, `feature/INDEX.md`, `reference/INDEX.md`,
   455	   `collaboration/INDEX.md`, `archive/INDEX.md`.
   456	5. Move or link root-level stray docs into the right index.
   457	6. Add the required reading rule to `AGENTS.md`.
   458	7. Add module-level `INDEX.md` for large modules.
   459	8. Mark historical docs as not read by default.
   460	9. Run a broken-link check.
   461	10. Report new navigation path and remaining historical debt.
   462	
   463	## Common Pitfalls
   464	
   465	1. **Too much in `AGENTS.md`** — it should be rules and navigation, not full design.
   466	2. **`OVERVIEW.md` becomes a giant manual** — overview is a map; move details down a layer.
   467	3. **Indexes only list filenames** — indexes must explain when to read each file.
   468	4. **Transient planning becomes repository SSOT** — keep temporary sequencing in the session and durable state in the owning README/GOAL.
   469	5. **Old docs at root with no status** — archive or index clearly.
   470	6. **No archive layer** — agents confuse historical plans with current requirements.
   471	7. **No write-back rule** — if new modules don't require index updates, the map rots.
   472	8. **Overgrown catch-all category** — an independent feature (own goal/milestones/contract, or ≥3 leaf docs) buried as leaf files under a mega-module; promote it to its own `docs/feature/<feature>/`.
   473	9. **Code changed, docs untouched** — non-trivial code/contract change shipped without updating the owning feature README + INDEX + OVERVIEW + back-links.
   474	
   475	## Audit Checklist
   476	
   477	- [ ] Agent can start from `AGENTS.md` and reach the right module without reading unrelated docs.
   478	- [ ] `docs/OVERVIEW.md` has a clear module table and docs navigation table.
   479	- [ ] `feature/INDEX.md` tells agents which module entrypoint to read.
   480	- [ ] Large modules have module-local routing.
   481	- [ ] Reference and archive docs are separated.
   482	- [ ] External collaboration cases preserve source ownership/version binding and translate accepted
   483	      recommendations into internal SSOT before implementation.
   484	- [ ] Current progress, blockers, and the next validation gate have one owning README/GOAL.
   485	- [ ] The project has exactly one current-mainline Feature pointer in OVERVIEW.
   486	- [ ] Each active Feature has one valid route manifest, stable internal node IDs, semantic user-facing names, an acyclic graph, explicit focus/parallel/join data, and one next gate.
   487	- [ ] Default progress output stays at L0 and upper indexes do not duplicate route summaries.
   488	- [ ] Active feature READMEs use independent state axes instead of composite lifecycle strings.
   489	- [ ] Active features have an append-only milestone changelog.
   490	- [ ] Contract-affecting implementation references one frozen Spec with confirmed requirements and accepted blocking ADRs.
   491	- [ ] Feature lifecycle, Spec lifecycle, requirements status, and decision status remain independent.
   492	- [ ] Before implementation, the active Spec freezes module ownership, dependency direction, public interfaces, file budgets, reuse boundaries, and test ownership.
   493	- [ ] New or changed handwritten code files are at most 1000 physical lines and files at 800 lines receive a decomposition review.
   494	- [ ] Oversized or mixed-responsibility extraction is routed through `refactor-large-modules` with frozen invariants and a validation matrix.
   495	- [ ] `禁止全量读取` or equivalent appears in agent-facing rules.
   496	- [ ] No critical broken links in active docs.
   497	- [ ] New docs write rules specify which indexes must be updated.
   498	- [ ] Each independent feature (own goal/milestones/contract, or ≥3 leaf docs) has its own `docs/feature/<feature>/`, not buried under a catch-all category.
   499	- [ ] Agent-facing rules require autonomous docs maintenance and proactive split of overgrown categories.

# Architecture

> 上级：[INDEX.md](INDEX.md)
> Feature 详细设计：[`../feature/report-generation/design.md`](../feature/report-generation/design.md)

本文件只持有跨模块稳定架构规则；报告模板、MVP 状态机和具体领域模型由 owning feature design 持有。

## System Boundary

```text
apps/api or apps/worker
  -> packages/orchestrator
      -> packages/domain + packages/contracts
      -> agentcore / research / evidence / renderer / policy / observability ports
          -> provider / parser / SQLite / filesystem / DOCX adapters
```

## Product Configuration Boundary

```text
Report Platform
  + versioned ReportTemplate
  + ProjectProfile
  + immutable ProjectKnowledgeSnapshot
  + ReportingPeriodInput
  = ReportJob + versioned artifacts
```

模板持有章节和版式；项目配置持有具体工程范围；领域数据和分析结果不得依赖章节编号。

## Control Layers

- **Report AgentLoop**：orchestrator 持有阶段机、输入门、分析调度、Agent 调用顺序、回流、人工介入和完成条件。
- **AgentCore**：单次受控 Agent 回合、结构化输出、工具调用、provider session、取消和 health。
- **Harness/runtime**：API/worker、SQLite、本地文件系统、凭证和 observability。

三层不能互相冒充：AgentCore 不拥有 Job 流程，orchestrator 不导入 provider SDK，runtime 不持有报告业务规则。

## Stable Rules

- `apps` 只负责 transport、进程生命周期和 dependency wiring。
- `domain`、`contracts` 不依赖 FastAPI、OpenAI、SQLite、DOCX 库或队列。
- `orchestrator` 只依赖显式 port；真实 adapter 通过入口注入。
- 原始资料解析、标准化和确定性计算先于 Agent 写作。
- LLM 不拥有计算公式、阈值、数据清洗、Job 状态或 artifact 发布。
- 每个正式数字必须追溯到 SourceLocation 和 AnalysisResult。
- renderer 只消费已批准 ReportBlock，不直接读取原始资料或调用模型。
- mutable state 必须有唯一 owner；trace/JSONL 不能代替业务数据库的当前状态。
- MVP local-only、read-only-by-default，不使用 Web 搜索或托管资料库。

## Current Implementation

当前没有业务实现。仓库只冻结了架构合同和空 package 边界；implemented behavior 仍为 none。

- **Harness/runtime**：API/worker、SQLite、本地文件系统、凭证和 observability。

三层不能互相冒充：AgentCore 不拥有 Job 流程，orchestrator 不导入 provider SDK，runtime 不持有报告业务规则。

## Stable Rules

- `apps` 只负责 transport、进程生命周期和 dependency wiring。
- `domain`、`contracts` 不依赖 FastAPI、OpenAI、SQLite、DOCX 库或队列。
- `orchestrator` 只依赖显式 port；真实 adapter 通过入口注入。

- LLM 不拥有计算公式、阈值、数据清洗、Job 状态或 artifact 发布。
- 每个正式数字必须追溯到 SourceLocation 和 AnalysisResult。
- renderer 只消费已批准 ReportBlock，不直接读取原始资料或调用模型。
- mutable state 必须有唯一 owner；trace/JSONL 不能代替业务数据库的当前状态。
- MVP local-only、read-only-by-default，不使用 Web 搜索或托管资料库。

## Current Implementation

当前没有业务实现。仓库只冻结了架构合同和空 package 边界；implemented behavior 仍为 none。

    monthly_change.py

    data_quality.py
    environment_monthly.py

packages/orchestrator/src/reportagent_orchestrator/
  state_machine.py
  handlers/
  gates/
  services/
  ports.py

  docx/
  audit_json.py

  ports.py

这些是责任路由，不要求在第一个 commit 一次性创建全部叶子。

# Interfaces

> 上级：[INDEX.md](INDEX.md)
> Feature 详细设计：[`../feature/report-generation/design.md`](../feature/report-generation/design.md)

以下是首个实现切片前必须保持稳定的公共接口面，不表示已有对应代码。

## 1. Job API Surface

- `POST /v1/report-jobs`
- `GET /v1/report-jobs/{job_id}`
- `POST /v1/report-jobs/{job_id}/inputs`
- `POST /v1/report-jobs/{job_id}/approve`
- `POST /v1/report-jobs/{job_id}/cancel`
- `GET /v1/report-jobs/{job_id}/artifacts`
- `GET /v1/report-jobs/{job_id}/trace`

创建 Job 必须显式绑定：

- `template_id` / `template_version`；
- `project_id`；
- `reporting_period`；
- `project_knowledge_snapshot_id`；
- `source_snapshot_id`。

MVP 只接受 `safety-monitoring-monthly` / `1.0`。

## 2. Job State Contract

稳定状态：

- `CREATED`
- `PREPARING`
- `BINDING_INPUTS`
- `VALIDATING_INPUTS`
- `NEEDS_INPUT`
- `ANALYZING`
- `DRAFTING`
- `VERIFYING`
- `NEEDS_REVIEW`
- `RENDERING`
- `COMPLETED`
- `FAILED`
- `CANCELLED`

每次迁移生成 append-only `PhaseEvent`，包含 from/to、reason、attempt、timestamp 和 trace reference。

## 3. AgentCore Port

- `run(request) -> result`
- `stream(request) -> async events`
- `continue_run(session_id, input, metadata) -> result`
- `cancel(session_id)`
- `health() -> provider status`

`AgentTurnRequest` 至少包含：

- role；
- prompt version；
- structured input；
- output schema ID；
- allowed tool IDs；
- session ID；
- Job/section metadata。

`AgentTurnResult` 至少包含：

- normalized status；
- structured output；
- usage；
- provider trace reference；
- normalized error。

OpenAI SDK 类型不得出现在 port 或 orchestrator 公共接口。

## 4. Source and Evidence Ports

- `scan_source(root) -> SourceSnapshot`
- `parse_source(source_file_id) -> SourceRecords`
- `query_sources(query, scope) -> SourceLocations`
- `save_observations(records) -> ObservationRefs`
- `get_evidence(evidence_ids) -> EvidenceRefs`
- `load_project_knowledge(snapshot_id) -> ProjectKnowledgeSnapshot`

每个 SourceLocation 必须携带 content hash 和可重定位位置；表格位置必须保留 workbook、Sheet 和 cell range。

## 5. Analysis Port

- `validate(recipe_id, context) -> ValidationResult`
- `run(recipe_id, context) -> AnalysisResult`
- `get_result(result_id) -> AnalysisResult`

AnalysisResult 必须是版本化、可序列化、可重算的结构化对象，不得只返回自然语言。

## 6. Renderer Port

- `render_docx(report, template_ref) -> ArtifactRef`
- `render_audit_json(report) -> ArtifactRef`
- `render_debug_markdown(report) -> ArtifactRef`
- `validate_artifact(artifact_ref) -> ArtifactValidationResult`

Renderer 只接受已批准 ReportBlock 和 artifact metadata，不读取原始监测文件。

## 7. Repository Ports

至少需要：

- `JobRepository`
- `SourceRepository`
- `ObservationRepository`
- `EvidenceRepository`
- `AnalysisRepository`
- `ReportRepository`
- `ArtifactRepository`

SQLite adapter 必须遵循相同 repository contract；orchestrator 不接触 SQL row。

## 8. Contract Rules

- 请求、事件、结果、错误和 artifact 使用结构化 schema。
- job、source snapshot、knowledge snapshot、monitoring unit、observation、analysis result、report block、artifact 和 trace ID 的 owner 唯一。
- 取消和补输入操作必须幂等。
- provider、parser、SQLite 和 DOCX 专用类型不得泄漏到稳定公共接口。
- schema 变化必须先更新 feature requirements/design，再更新 contract tests 和实现。

    49

    51	- `stream(request) -> async events`

    96	
    97	- `render_docx(report, template_ref) -> ArtifactRef`
    98	- `render_audit_json(report) -> ArtifactRef`
    99	- `render_debug_markdown(report) -> ArtifactRef`
   100	- `validate_artifact(artifact_ref) -> ArtifactValidationResult`
   101	
   102	Renderer 只接受已批准 ReportBlock 和 artifact metadata，不读取原始监测文件。

   104	## 7. Repository Ports
   105	
   106	至少需要：
   107

   111	- `EvidenceRepository`

   113	- `ReportRepository`
   114	- `ArtifactRepository`

   117	
   118	## 8. Contract Rules
   119	
   120	- 请求、事件、结果、错误和 artifact 使用结构化 schema。
   121	- job、source snapshot、knowledge snapshot、monitoring unit、observation、analysis result、report block、artifact 和 trace ID 的 owner 唯一。
   122	- 取消和补输入操作必须幂等。

    13	
    14	## 2026-07-21 — Stable monthly report MVP architecture frozen
    15

    27
